citations.narrative:
The written Program of Veterinary Care (PVC) is not complete and does not include a schedule for sampling for parasites
and other pests (including fleas, worms, coccidia, giardia, and heartworm). A facility representative confirmed the animals
are not excluded from sampling due to research protocols. Failure to have a schedule for parasite sampling may cause
the animals to not be adequately protected from parasites.
The written program of veterinary care must address the requirements for adequate veterinary care and must include
vaccinations for contagious and/or deadly diseases of dogs (including rabies, parvovirus, and distemper) and sampling
and treatment of parasites and other pests (including fleas, worms, coccidia, giardia, and heartworm) in accordance with a
schedule approved by the attending veterinarian. Correct by having the Attending Veterinarian update, approve, and sign
the written program of veterinary care with all the required information. Correct by 23-SEP-2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with Facility Representatives.
